readback_body:
## Requirements: Inspect persistent Workspace overlay ownership and image dependencies

**Priority:** P2. **Owner:** Agent Workspace inventory / Sandbox read-only resource detail.

### Execution priority revision · 2026-11-17

Wave 3 — optional detail of managed Writable Workspace usage after Images management and runtime consumption; does not block delivering Image Library/Build/Prepare.

### Problem and required behavior
Enhance the existing Agent-owned Workspaces section with an inline resource detail for resolved lowers, upper/work ownership, current lease/mount status, persistent bytes, Agent identity and linked Sessions. Do not expose raw private paths/grants or invent a second global Workspace registry. Keep Project Existing Locations explicitly user-owned and prevent deletion while leased.

**Source audit (2026-11-17 main):** `web/src/capabilities/sandbox/components/SandboxWorkspacesPanel.tsx`, `crates/nession-agent/src/workspace_manager.rs`, `crates/nession-sandbox/src/mount/overlay`. Linked accepted boundaries: #3407 #3582 #3695 #3408. Preserve existing historical Acceptance; this Requirement owns **new product behavior**, not a re-verdict on those Issues.

### Design boundary and ordering
- Production owner remains as above; never introduce duplicate Image Registry/Build queue/Agent cache or global Sandbox Workspace.
- Preserve one pinned immutable Digest and explicit ownership/recovery through the Session/Workspace lifecycle; do not silently fall back when the necessary capability is absent.
- Web/App use current Nession ResourceDetail/ConfigurationForm/OperationSurface, one shell/Header owner, progressive disclosure. No unverified behavior may be presented as shipped.
- This Issue may be developed independently, but contracts shared with #3407 #3582 #3695 #3408 require a source-aligned review before implementation.

### Success Criteria
- [ ] SC-01 Selecting a managed Workspace exposes source image digests, durable writable-store identity, measured usage if available, actual lease/mount/Session consumers and update time; Project Location visibly remains user-owned with no delete action.
- [x] SC-02 Delete is disabled/refused while leased, and a failed/offline resource observation cannot be mistaken for mounted or safe-to-delete; readback cannot disclose unapproved host details.

**Verification scenarios:** SC-01 → SCN-02; SC-02 → SCN-01. PR `agent` decisions consume only exact-SHA source/deterministic CI proof; merged `case` runs reuse approved Nession Chromium Web/App and/or isolated Server-Agent Linux runtime lanes, with trusted Run/Attempt/SHA receipts. Native mount guarantees require actual capability-probed Linux runner; no mock-only Pass.

## Acceptance Plan

```yaml
  SC-02:

```

## Acceptance Report

| Criterion | Result | Evidence |

| SC-01 | Pending | Awaiting independently authenticated exact-SHA SCN-02 proof |
| SC-02 | Pass | run 44313717608; ref ff8ac69d692518a0d0fd74410bc223b1f60c58aa; source agent-qwen; file: crates/nession-agent/src/workspace_manager.rs:601-612 - delete() refuses while lease_count > 0 or observation.in_use is Some; file: crates/nession-agent/src/workspace_manager.rs:440-471 - status_for() returns InUse/Missing/Error rather than Available for failed observations; file: crates/nession-agent/src/workspace_manager.rs:130-133 - Comment documents consumers are Session names only, never host paths/grants; file: web/src/capabilities/sandbox/model.ts:499-517 - workspaceDeleteBlockReason() returns non-null for in_use/missing/error/unobserved, only available permits delete; file: web/src/capabilities/sandbox/components/SandboxWorkspacesPanel.tsx:129 - Delete button disabled={busy \|\| deleteBlock !== null}; file: web/src/capabilities/sandbox/components/SandboxWorkspaceDetail.tsx:66 - Managed workspaces show workspace_id, not raw host paths; file: crates/nession-sandbox/src/mount/overlay/manager.rs:1295-1307 - Foreign mounts are never adopted by path; Orphaned state is explicit; file: crates/nession-agent/src/workspace_manager.rs:1079-1097 - Test delete_refuses_a_lease_and_removes_the_unleased_workspace verifies lease refusal; summary: Delete is disabled in UI (workspaceDeleteBlockReason returns non-null for in_use/missing/error/unobserved) and refused in backend (lease_count > 0 or observation.in_use returns error); failed/offline observations return Error/Missing status which blocks deletion with explicit 'not proven safe' message; readback shows only Session names and opaque workspace_id, never raw host paths for managed workspaces. |
